superseded_receipt.proof_boundary: On integer triples, d0(f0, f1, f2) = (f1 - f0, f2 - f1, f2 - f0) is linear, (delta + d0(g)) - d0(f + g) = delta - d0(f), and the absolute residual sum is unchanged by that shift. For delta = (1, 1, 0), every integer repair has absolute residual sum at least 2, the repair (0, 1, 0) attains 2, and both facts survive every integer coboundary shift. A general cost, a real or complex repair space, weighted duality on an arbitrary complex, rational repairs, and a general coefficient field stay outside this module.
